summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software engineer, extensive experience in web development and video streaming technologies, strong interest in open-source software, avid reader of technology and programming literature, critical of corporate practices regarding user privacy and data security, engaged in discussions about software development methodologies, enjoys motorcycling, particularly Ducati and MV Agusta brands, has lived in multiple countries including the USA and various locations in Africa, values plain language in legal documents, advocates for user-friendly technology, has a family structure that includes children, emphasizes the importance of education and learning in technology fields.
